title: F5 sin vídeo cerrado sin traducir-subtitulos ni resumir-reunion
source: 07-7-catalogo-completo-de-herramientas.md §7.10; 17-17-fases-y-entregables.md; docs/PLAN.md (F5 lote E, F3 lote E); docs/DECISIONS.md D-119
detail: I compared every F1, F2 and F5 slug in 7.1–7.11, 7.22 and 7.23 with the 157 entries in packages/registry/registry.json. All F1 slugs are there (45) and all F2 slugs are there (60). From F5 without video, only traducir-subtitulos and resumir-reunion (7.10, phase F5) are missing. They were moved to 'F3 lote E' because they need the LLM, yet PLAN.md and PROGRESS.md call F5 sin vídeo 'cerrado'. conversor-pdf, crear-pdf and convertir-archivo are built as fixed pages (apps/web/src/lib/site.ts STATIC_PAGES), not as registry entries, which is correct. No registry entry has launch=false. The only tools off by default are the three behind HEVC (see the separate item). Both missing tools can be built and tested with the fake LLM provider (D-126). Their audio path needs FFmpeg and faster-whisper, and FFmpeg is not on this machine; a static LGPL BtbN build could be downloaded the same way workers/Dockerfile does it. Real use needs the owner's OpenRouter key. The F3 tools still missing (imagen-a-texto, imagen-a-excel, ticket-a-excel, pdf-a-audio) are outside this check.

detail: heic-a-pdf (F2), heic-a-jpg and heic-a-png (F5) are off in production because HEVC_DECODE_ENABLED is off (flags.ts THEMATIC); this follows 7.2. Rule 1.7 says every disabled tool must have its reason written in docs/TOOLS.md. TOOLS.md never mentions HEVC and lists these tools as normal. It is generated by scripts/gen_docs.py, so the fix belongs in the generator: add a 'Desactivadas' section with the flag and the reason. Turning the flag on needs the owner's legal review in LEGAL.md.

It is on the launch list, and 17.1 says no phase closes with tools below their Anexo A options. It needs a hybrid or server path (OSD in workerocr). title: Sin miniaturas de página en organizar, eliminar, extraer, dividir y girar (A.4)

detail: A.4 asks for drag-and-drop thumbnails (organizar-pdf), click per page (eliminar and extraer), scissors between thumbnails (dividir, Personalizado) and rotation per page. The web has no page-thumbnail component for these tools. OptionsForm.tsx shows the array 'orden' as a comma-separated text box with the placeholder 'spa, eng', and por_pagina as text '3:90, 5:180'. File order in ToolRunner uses ↑/↓ buttons instead of dragging (A.1 and A.4 say 'orden por arrastre'). These are all F1 launch tools. The PDFium renderer in the worker (viewer/PdfViewer.tsx) can be reused.

title: ocr-pdf: «Quitar fondo» y «Limpiar páginas» fallan
source: a-5-a-5-optimizar-y-reparar.md (ocr-pdf); packages/tools/tools/ocr/ocr_pdf.py:44-45; .venv ocrmypdf 17.13.0 _pipeline.py preprocess_remove_background; workers/Dockerfile (worker-ocr apt list)
detail: ocr_pdf.py passes remove_background=o.quitar_fondo straight to OCRmyPDF 17.13. That version raises NotImplementedError('--remove-background is temporarily not implemented') on any grey or colour page, and ocr_pdf.py does not catch NotImplementedError. A.5 requires in-house OpenCV preprocessing when the pinned version cannot do it. «Limpiar» (clean=True) needs unpaper, and unpaper is not installed in the worker-ocr image (its apt line installs tesseract, java and so on, but not unpaper). No test enables either option. ocr-pdf is on the launch list. Tesseract and unpaper are not on this machine, so testing needs CI.

title: comprimir-pdf sin el optimizador de OCRmyPDF ni JBIG2
source: 07-7 §7.5 (comprimir-pdf «más el optimizador de OCRmyPDF»); a-5-a-5-optimizar-y-reparar.md (Compresión moderna: JPEG 2000 y JBIG2 sin pérdida); 11-11-licencias.md (jbig2enc externo); packages/tools/tools/pdf/comprimir_pdf.py
detail: comprimir_pdf.py recompresses with Pillow (JPEG, or JPEG2000 when compresion_moderna is on). It never calls the OCRmyPDF optimizer, and it never encodes 1-bit images as lossless JBIG2. jbig2enc (Apache-2.0, external program, allowed by 11) is not in any image. The optimizer path can be built with pip; JBIG2 needs jbig2enc, which is a system binary. F1 launch tool.

Under 1.7 no tool counts as 'lista' without its 8.2 content. 8.2.5 asks for, in each language, what it does, steps, FAQ, limits, formats and related tools, about 300 words, with no paragraph repeated on more than 3 pages (content.test.ts checks this). title: El entorno local no puede ejecutar el pytest que PROGRESS da por bueno
source: docs/PROGRESS.md «Cierre técnico» (308 en verde con PostgreSQL, Valkey, Tesseract, FFmpeg… reales); tests/conftest.py:20 (PG_BIN=/usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin)
detail: This machine has no docker, postgres, valkey or redis, tesseract, ffmpeg or ffprobe, tiffcp, ddjvu, ebook-convert, heif-dec, java, verapdf, unpaper, qpdf, pandoc or restic. It does have libreoffice, gs, pdftocairo, chrome, node 26 and python 3.13. conftest.py starts PostgreSQL 16 from /usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin, so the API, AI and chat-pdf tests (which also need pgvector) cannot run, and the '308 en verde' figure cannot be reproduced here. Possible ways round it without system packages: pip wheels that bundle PostgreSQL with pgvector, or Redis/Valkey binaries, passed in via TEST_DATABASE_URL and TEST_VALKEY_URL, plus a static LGPL FFmpeg from BtbN. The Tesseract, veraPDF, Calibre and DjVu tests will only run in CI. Vitest and the client-side Playwright tests do run here.

(9) No AGPL or GPL in images: check_images.sh has never run on a real image. (10) Workers without outbound access and secrets isolated: needs containers. (13) Remote copy and restore: pending. Already met: no S3 (grep finds no boto, s3 or minio), docs/ complete, retention and the disk and queue guards (tested), client tools sending nothing over the network (Playwright).

title: .env.example sin variables de la sección 14; Sentry y Umami sin integrar
source: 14-14-variables-de-entorno.md («.env.example con todas ellas»); 12-12-seguridad.md §12.5 (analítica sin cookies, Sentry si se activa)
detail: Missing from .env.example: SENTRY_DSN, UMAMI_URL, UMAMI_WEBSITE_ID, AUTH_SECRET, DATABASE_URL_WORKER and SERVICE_PASSWORD_WORKERDB (the last three are only in docker-compose.yml). detail: docs/TOOLS.md never mentions XPS, PostScript/EPS or PDF/X; G-code slicing; resin slicing formats; or proprietary CAD formats (as possible with a commercial licence or after legal review). title: Faltan muestras de 1.8 para las fases cerradas
source: 01-1-como-trabajar.md §1.8; tests/fixtures/SOURCES.md; scripts/fixtures/generate.py
detail: I found no digitally signed PDF and no 300-page PDF, both on the 1.8 list. A 300-page file would exercise the plan page limits (pdf_pages 300 on the free plan) and timing; a signed PDF would test that comprimir, proteger and editar warn about or keep the signature. The Python tests have no AcroForm fixture either; the TS tests build their own with pdf-lib. They could be generated in scripts/fixtures with pikepdf, pdf-lib or pyHanko (a test signature).
